enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Breathe. Turn on back. Place arm under pillow. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Breathe. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.

Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on tap. Brush teeth. Wash face. Turn on shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Dry body with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal box. Close refrigerator. Take bowl from cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Put milk back in refrigerator. Take spoon from drawer. Sit at table. Eat cereal with spoon. Drink milk from bowl. Stand up. Rinse bowl in sink. Place bowl in dishwasher. Wipe table. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close closet. Take off pajama top. Take off pajama bottoms. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up phone. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Exit elevator. Walk to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator at nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Type reply. Answer phone. Speak on phone. Hang up. Write notes. Attend meeting. Return to desk. Type document. Print document. Walk to printer. Pick up document. Return to desk. Staple document. File document. Turn off computer. Stand up. Walk out of office.

Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Press ground floor button. Exit elevator. Walk out of building. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk home. Enter home. Walk to bedroom. Put down bag.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add meat. Add vegetables. Turn off stove. Take plate from cabinet. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat with fork. Drink water. Stand up. Rinse plate. Place plate in dishwasher. Wipe table.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on couch. Change channel. Watch TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Drink. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Turn on computer. Open browser. Type email. Send email. Open social media. Scroll feed. Close browser. Open game. Play game. Exit game. Turn off computer. Pick up phone. Put phone down. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up. Walk to bed. Sit on bed.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Dry body with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Close book. Put book on nightstand. Turn off bedside lamp. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Breathe. Turn on back. Place arm under pillow. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Breathe. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Sleep.
